
## Feature Request Template

```markdown
---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: feature, needs-triage
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Description
Describe the new feature you want.

## Problem / Motivation
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
Explain how the feature should work.

## User Story
As a [type of user], I want [goal], so that [benefit].

Example:
As a student, I want to filter tasks by due date, so that I can see urgent work first.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Possible Tasks
- [ ] Design UI
- [ ] Create backend/API logic
- [ ] Add frontend implementation
- [ ] Add tests
- [ ] Update documentation

## Screenshots / Mockups
Add images, sketches, or links if available.

## Priority
- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
- [ ] Critical

## Additional Context
Add any other information here.
